args.body: Coordinate with the recorded owner of CONTRACTS-FINDER-SMALL-DATA-QA and reuse any completed result. Use the saved official feed and director-tender-navigation.json if committed. Check the feed shape before interpreting any zero count. Under the mission's existing limits, prioritize an original current notice with a separately quotable offline data QA deliverable. Verify the deadline, supplier conditions, submission route and buyer acceptance criterion in the original notice or tender documents. If one qualifies, execute the existing checker on a fictional pass and fail tied to that criterion and prepare a private unsent quote with explicit exclusions and any submission or settlement dependencies. Otherwise record exactly what the saved feed and original notices covered and what buyer evidence would reopen the route. Read back committed evidence before closing under the actual lease with a lesson. Keep any quote unsent and preserve independent review before any public deployment.

description: The official Contracts Finder tender feed returned HTTP 200 and was saved. That gives us a new source to screen for a buyer requesting standalone data QA. The next step is to verify a current original notice and, if its scope and response conditions fit, turn one buyer acceptance criterion into an executed work sample and a private quote. Commercial feedback is available but five sources remain unclassified, so the absence of classified requests leaves demand unknown. Verified available funds and verified revenue are both zero. The procurement test can proceed with the available tools, while the staged SQLite release still requires independent approval of its exact digest.
